Definition: from κυβερνάω (of Latin origin, to steer); pilotage, i.e. (figuratively) directorship (in the church):--government.
BiblicalUsage: Governments here is the gift of steering, and it appears once, in the list of gifts God set in the church in 1 Corinthians 12:28: apostles, prophets, teachers, miracles, healings, helps, "governments," diversities of tongues.
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, the word is a quiet correction to how I think about leadership: governing the church is a gift of the Spirit, like healing and teaching, and it is given to serve, not to rule.
